title: Assessing Kabir's personality
body: A school counsellor wants to understand Kabir, a Class 12 student who has recently become withdrawn. She first gives him a self-report inventory in which he marks each statement as 'true' or 'false'. Kabir knows that his personality is being assessed. His answers present him as cheerful, confident and free of worries, which does not match what his teachers have noticed. The counsellor suspects that he answered in a socially desirable manner and that some of his feelings may not be fully conscious to him. She now considers other methods: showing him picture cards and asking him to tell a story about each one, asking his classmates to name the person with whom they would most like to study, or holding an interview with a fixed set of specific questions.
